form.label: DOC - Network Baselining with Zeek Logs
form.description: Comprehensive guide for network baselining using Zeek logs and Splunk queries

html.p: This dashboard provides comprehensive Splunk queries and visualizations for network baselining using Zeek logs.
Monitor and baseline remote access protocols in your environment.

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=3389 OR service="rdp") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, username, client_name, ciphers, rdp.client.build
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=22 OR service="ssh") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, username, host_key, kex_algorithms
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=23 OR service="telnet") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, username, cmd, password
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=5900 OR service="vnc") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, password, display
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=21 OR service="ftp") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, username
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=445 OR service="smb" OR service="cifs") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, smb_cmd, smb_tree
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=143 OR service="imap") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, imap.command, imap.arg
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=110 OR service="pop3") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, pop3.command, pop3.arg
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=161 OR service="snmp") | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, snmp.community, snmp.version

html.p: Note: RPC port numbers can vary, customize based on your environment.

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" service="rpc" | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, rpc.operation, rpc.object

html.p: Analyze process execution events using Zeek logs.
Search for process execution-related connections. Replace <server_ip> with your actual server IP:

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_orig_h=<server_ip> OR id_resp_h=<server_ip>) service=http OR service=https | table _time, id_orig_h, id_orig_p, id_resp_h, id_resp_p, service, proto

html.p: Search for file transfers indicating process execution events:

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:files" (tx_hosts=<server_ip> OR rx_hosts=<server_ip>) | table _time, tx_hosts, rx_hosts, mime_type, filename

html.p: Create visualizations to identify anomalous behavior in your network.
Visualize frequency of connections over time:

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_orig_h=<server_ip> OR id_resp_h=<server_ip>) service=http OR service=https | timechart span=1h count

html.p: Visualization: Chart > Time Chart
Bar chart showing top source IP addresses:

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_orig_h=<server_ip> OR id_resp_h=<server_ip>) service=http OR service=https | top id_orig_h limit=10

html.p: Visualization: Chart > Bar Chart
Distribution of transferred file types:

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:files" (tx_hosts=<server_ip> OR rx_hosts=<server_ip>) | chart count by mime_type

html.p: Visualization: Chart > Column Chart
Anomaly detection using ML Toolkit:

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_orig_h=<server_ip> OR id_resp_h=<server_ip>) service=http OR service=https | mstats avg(count) as avg_conn by _time span=1h | `outliers(avg_conn)`

html.p: Visualization: Machine Learning > Outlier Detection
Additional visualization techniques for network anomaly detection.

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" | timechart span=1h count as "Connection Count"

html.p: Visualization: Time Chart - Track connection counts to spot spikes or unusual patterns

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" | iplocation id_orig_h | geostats sum(count) as "Connection Count" by lat, lon

html.p: Visualization: Geographical Heat Map - Display connection frequencies by location

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" | stats count by service | eval Service=coalesce(service, "Unknown") | chart count by Service

html.p: Visualization: Donut Chart - Examine protocol distribution

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" | top limit=10 id_orig_h

html.p: Visualization: Bar Chart - Top hosts by connection count
Queries to identify different types of servers in your environment.

pre.code: sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=80 OR id_resp_p=443) uri_path="/api/v4/internal/allowed" method="POST" | stats values(id_resp_h) as servers
sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=80 OR id_resp_p=443) | stats values(id_resp_h) as servers
sourcetype="zeek:kerberos" | stats values(id_resp_h) as servers
sourcetype="zeek:dns" | stats values(id_resp_h) as servers

html.p: Comprehensive server discovery query combining multiple server types:

pre.code: | multisearch [ index=zeek sourcetype="zeek:conn" id_resp_p=53 AND service="dns" zdns.qtype_name="SRV" | eval ServerName=id_resp_h, ServerType="Domain Controller (DC)", ServerIP=id_resp_h | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP ] [ index=zeek sourcetype="zeek:kerberos" | eval ServerName=id_resp_h, ServerType="Kerberos", ServerIP=id_resp_h | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP ] [ index=zeek sourcetype="zeek:dns" | eval ServerName=id_resp_h, ServerType="DNS Server", ServerIP=id_resp_h | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP ] [ index=zeek sourcetype="zeek:http" | eval ServerName=id_resp_h, ServerType="Web Server", ServerIP=id_resp_h | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP ] [ index=zeek sourcetype="zeek:conn" (id_resp_p=21 OR service="ftp") | eval ServerName=id_resp_h, ServerType="FTP Server", ServerIP=id_resp_h | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP ] [ index=zeek sourcetype="zeek:http" uri_path="/api/v4/internal/allowed" method="POST" | eval ServerName=id_resp_h, ServerType="GitLab", ServerIP=id_resp_h | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP ] | dedup ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP | table ServerName, ServerType, ServerIP
